title: Cassandra's Podcast - Videos
description: I created a four part podcast called the Dyslexic Dossier podcast for my Girl Scout Gold Award. Each episode I interview versus people such as a psychologist and teachers to talk about dyslexia and what to look for when identifying in young children. I also dive into my own journey with dyslexia and my struggles to give teen something to relate to. From each episode I want people to take away how you can better help your child in the public education setting!
